# P211 — kernel--image projection feedback

Current evidence includes accepted author/A/B strict replay pairs, both actual
manuscript reviews and same-reviewer no-change deltas, physical Round0/1/2,
two accepted terminal source-only builds, five actual final-page views and
complete terminal artifact/diagnostic reception. The separate full scientific
reuse-key check is also accepted. The [final QA map](FINAL_QA_REPORT.md) and
[root lifecycle decision](../../docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p211_lifecycle_root01/RECEPTION.md)
govern current single-paper completion; this README alone does not supply a
missing gate or complete the five-paper batch. The [batch index](../../docs/papers211_215_sequence/PIPELINE_STATE.md)
tracks the remaining papers. External status remains OWNER_AMBER/HOLD_EXTERNAL.

The final [five-page PDF](qa_final/cold_build_1/inner/source_only/main.pdf)
and independently built [second PDF](qa_final/cold_build_2/inner/source_only/main.pdf)
are byte-identical. Each final log retains one font-expansion warning and two
underfull messages, explicitly accepted as nonblocking for this exact readable
artifact. This is not a zero-warning or internal font-expansion correctness
claim. The source-version/causality limitation and all earlier failures remain.

## Content and result ceiling

The anonymous internal `amsart` manuscript proves the exact terminal
projection, complete fixed/recurrent set and pointwise/sharp clock of the
recomputed kernel--image feedback, together with a complete labelled-target
predecessor decoder and finite Laurent/binomial count. It has no global
fibre maximum, maximizer, basin or all-time inverse claim.

- `NARRATIVE_REPORT.md`, `PAPER_PLAN.md`, `CLAIMS_EVIDENCE.md` bind the
  story, scope and evidence obligations.
- `main.tex`, `math_commands.tex`, `references.bib`, and six modular
  `sections/*.tex` files form the complete manuscript source.
- `PROOF_PACKAGE.md` restates the same admitted four claims with complete
  assumptions, strategy, dependency map and all proofs.
- `SOURCE_AUDIT.md` credits the published primitives and records the
  version-specific source boundaries; actual newly saved browser returns
  are in `sources/`.
- `verify.py`, `parameters.json`, `PARAMETER_SPECIFICATION.md`, and
  `CANONICAL_SCHEMA.md` define a fresh standalone author verifier and its
  complete finite output. [CANONICAL.json](CANONICAL.json) is the immutable,
  root-adopted 1,327,062-byte actual initial stdout, not a pilot conversion.
- `PREPARATION_PLAN.md` is the exact source/interface/production/runtime/
  build plan with execution status updated; it is not permission for a new run.
- `AUTHOR_EXECUTION_RECEIPT.md` records the accepted initial/adoption/pair
  milestone and separates it from this documentation-only update.
- `INITIAL_BUILD_RECEIPT.md` and `main.pdf` record the subsequently accepted
  initial source-only build and root all-page viewing, not a terminal pair.

## Retained mathematical result

The accepted conjunction is the full-carrier endpoint trajectory/core and
sharp clock for the literal support-recomputed kernel–image feedback, plus
a complete labelled-target one-step inverse atlas and evaluated finite
Laurent/binomial counting formula. See the unchanged [proof](PROOF_PACKAGE.md),
[manuscript source](main.tex) and [source audit](SOURCE_AUDIT.md).
Published support/rank primitives and static projection-product mechanisms
are deducted. There is no global fibre maximum/maximizer, basin census,
all-time inverse formula, universal no-factor theorem or global novelty claim.

The original seven complete carriers n=1,…,7 contain 2,353 source states and
every possible target, including zero fibres. These finite checks pressure
the deductive proofs; they do not establish all-n statements.
